crew_disinhibition.process: The resonance field is progressively suppressing prefrontal cortex executive function while flooding dopamine and oxytocin pathways. The crew is aware, which adds a layer of dark comedy — they can observe themselves losing control and narrate it with professional detachment even as they act on impulses they would normally suppress.
stages: Stage 1 (days 1-4): Lowered social filters. Blunt honesty. Saying what they actually think about colleagues. Mild.
Stage 2 (days 5-8): Emotional amplification. Laughter, tears, anger all heightened. Sexual ideation becomes intrusive and discussed openly. Moderate.

Stage 3 (days 9-12, current): Active disinhibition. Difficulty maintaining professional boundaries. Physical contact-seeking. Sexual tension pervasive and acted on between willing crew. Impulse control requires conscious effort.
Stage 4 (days 13-18): Executive function significantly compromised. Complex tasks become difficult. Emotional reasoning dominates. The ship begins to struggle operationally.
Stage 5 (day 19+): Crew cannot maintain ship operations. The resonance is not lethal to females but it will effectively disable them if unchecked.
crew_disinhibition.nearest_people_see: Everyone. They talk about it constantly. It is the elephant in every room, except the elephant is horny and nobody can stop making jokes about it.

warp_failure.process: Dilithium matrix micro-fractures from harmonic resonance stress. Getting worse.

If unfixed in 12 days: Risk of cascade failure affecting impulse drive.

comms_absorption.process: Subspace transmissions absorbed by resonance field. Array functional but output is swallowed.
stages: Current: No outgoing or incoming subspace. Internal comms functional.
The resonance field is intensifying as the lattice refines its signal. Comms will not restore naturally — they will get worse.

lattice_awakening.process: The lattice consciousness is becoming more active, more structured, more intentional. Its resonance output is evolving from noise toward signal.
stages: Weeks 1-2 (past): Broad, unfocused resonance. Biological side effects unintentional.
Week 2-3 (current): Resonance developing structure. Side effects becoming more targeted — the lattice is learning.
Week 3-4: The lattice begins producing effects that are unmistakably intentional — objects moved, systems activated, patterns in the ship's displays. First contact pressure.
Week 4+: The lattice attempts direct neural contact with whoever is most receptive. That is the player character.
